items.html: And know that in the belly of the supernal Ima only the aspect of the ZON of Atzilut are sorted, and no more. And in the belly of the Nukva of ZA is sorted the head of Beriah, up to the Aba and Ima in Beriah. And we have already written that, because of the reason that the aspect of a coupling of male and female cannot be mentioned except from the aspect of Aba and Ima and below alone, therefore we include in these our words all the three upper ones in Beriah together; but the intelligent one will understand the truth from his own mind.
